installDesc: Add the panel to your home screen or desktop. It opens like an app.
installUnavailable: Your browser has not offered installation. Use Chrome, Edge or Safari on an HTTPS address.
installIos: On iPhone or iPad, tap Share, then Add to Home Screen.
pushDesc: Get server and deploy alerts on this device, even when the panel is closed.
pushBlocked: Notifications are blocked for this site. Allow them in your browser settings.
pushUnsupported: This browser cannot receive push notifications.
pushIosHint: On iPhone or iPad, install the app first, then turn push on.
channelHint: Choose which alerts reach your devices in Notifications.
offlineBody: Tugra needs a connection to reach your servers. Check your network and try again.
